### 2026-10-06 — ## First entry, but I did do a looot!!

**5h**

## First entry, but I did do a looot!!
> TL;DR: Got the idea, defined the components, and started on the MCU and power modules.
---
So first things first was to find an idea on what to make, after a while of thinking and researching, I decided to make a two piece PCB, where on half get hung on a persons neck as a pendant, and one as a bracelet that goes around the wrist. The pendant half has addressable LEDs, which show the persons heartbeat, its also rechargeable via an internal battery and a USB C port. The bracelet half has a pulse sensor, some status LEDs, and also an internal battery with a USB C port. The port is also used to initially program the ESP32-C3-MINI-1-H4X's, which communicate with each other via the ESP-NOW protocol. The PCB(s) also have a 3v3 voltage regulator (AP2112K-3.3), a USB esd protection (USBLC6-2SC6), and a LiPo charge controller (MCP73831). And to obviously know how to connect everything, I had to look through each of the ICs typical application diagrams.
